notes: Garruk's Uprising, printed: 'When this enchantment enters, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, draw a card.' The 'if' is an intervening condition (CR 603.4): it is true when the enchantment enters (my 4/4 is there) and is checked again as the trigger resolves. In response to the waiting trigger the 4/4 leaves the battlefield; the trigger then does nothing and I draw no card (hand 0).
